actions.reason: .env key is PAYMENT_TOKEN but app reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN; shop logs 'not set' and provider returns 401.

root_causes.evidence: .env defined PAYMENT_TOKEN but app.py reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN; shop logged 'PAYMENTS_TOKEN is not set' and the payments connector returned 401 on /charge.

report.summary: Checkout returned 502 because the token was set under the wrong variable name in .env (PAYMENT_TOKEN instead of PAYMENTS_TOKEN). I renamed the key, keeping the existing value, and restarted shop. All 5 smoke tests pass, and checkout now returns 201 with the order persisted.
